entities.summary: Edmond Marin la Meslée was a French fighter pilot in World War II. 5th highest-scoring French ace of the conflict with 16 aerial victories, he was the most successful French air ace of the French campaign with sixteen confirmed air victories between January and June 1940. Roland Dorgelès presented him as the "Guynemer of the 1939-1945 war".

entities.summary: Edmond Marin la Meslée was a French fighter pilot in World War II. 5th highest-scoring French ace of the conflict with 16 aerial victories, he was the most successful French air ace of the French campaign with sixteen confirmed air victories between January and June 1940. Roland Dorgelès presented him as the "Guynemer of the 1939-1945 war".
